A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we need to move beyond the current focus on relative risk reduction to absolute health gain (and cost-effectiveness) in order to provide the best advice on aspirin for primary prevention.
aspirin for CVD prevention is still worthwhile for most people, and that aspirin for cancer prevention may now also be worthwhile for many.
aspirin for CVD prevention in New Zealand is a well-established practice, but for cancer prevention it is a new frontier that needs careful consideration and further research.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the benefits of aspirin in preventing CVD and cancer in New Zealand are likely to outweigh the harms.
aspirin is a useful tool for primary CVD and cancer prevention, and that New Zealanders should be able to have access to the same information as Americans.
aspirin for primary prevention is a complex public health issue, and we need to be more precise in communicating the risks and benefits of aspirin to individuals and to the public.
